product_metadata.title: Fab Habitat 2 Tier Hanging Macrame Boho Basket - Handmade, Natural, Jute & Rattan - Organizer for Plants, Fruit, Flowers, Vegetables, Greenery - Kitchen, Home Décor - Prairie
features: Keep it tidy and stylish - These baskets not only look fabulous but also make the perfect home storage solution; ideal for holding houseplants, fruits; veggies and even decorative items.
Just for you - Because this item is carefully made by hand, no two will look exactly alike; Yours will be one-of-a-kind; top basket is 8" in diameter; bottom basket is 11" diameter. overall 28" long.
Trendy yet versatile - Our unique macrame baskets are light yet sturdy and make for a stylish addition anywhere indoors whether your kitchen, bathroom, closet or even by the fireplace.
All-natural materials - Our eco-conscious hanging baskets are handmade with all-natural jute and rattan by trained adult artisans.

Certified Fair Trade - Our baskets have been approved by the World Fair Trade Organization. We set high standards to ensure everything we sell has been made with respect to people and our planet.Actual colors and size may vary from the image(s) shown due to manufacturing limitations with natural materials.
description: Create your own storage space with our hanging macrame baskets. Made with entirely eco-conscious jute that's made to last, these trendy wide woven nets are perfect for storing a multitude of items. Why not give your potted plants a boost? The Prairie is perfect for holding houseplants, bowls full of fruit or other decorative items.
